notes: Add your own pictures: drag them onto the video, make them round, add a border or shadow, or put them behind the video
Stickers, and My logo: save your logo once and put it on every clip
Two new templates: Creator post and Gamer banner
Captions: import SRT or VTT, paste your text or tap along to time it, with speaker names in colour
AI captions (Pro, free in the beta): Fragmio listens to your video and writes timed captions, fully offline, in English and Hindi
Auto-sync (Pro, free in the beta): your pasted lines line up with the voice by themselves
Words and Karaoke animations: words appear or light up exactly as they are spoken
Gradient text and shadows in any direction
Pro features now show a PRO label (everything stays free during the beta)
Galleries and caption lines open beside the video instead of covering it
The colour picker follows the mouse smoothly
Editing is paused while the video file is missing, so nothing changes by mistake
